details:
Q1
Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / clarify-respond workflows.
B. Plan / implement workflows.
C. Review autofix / orchestrate / validate workflows.
D. Docs / README / operator guidance.
E. Another specific file, script, or workflow — reply with its exact path/name. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What should “better” mean for that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior, failing run, or regression. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change behavior.
C. Improve reliability, performance, or cost without changing intended behavior.
D. Improve docs, usability, or onboarding.
Q3
What concrete signal should define “done”?
Choices:
A. A specific issue, PR, workflow run, or log symptom should stop happening — include the link, number, or exact error text. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file/workflow/script should change — include its exact name/path.
C. A specific operator or user task should become easier — describe the before/after.
D. No exact symptom — make the smallest safe improvement in the area from Q1.
